protocol.reason: Original three-arm calibration stopped as declared because plain SGD did not qualify anywhere in the fixed grid. Before any comparison-batch scoring, retain only the two native directions already qualified on all three calibration batches at their largest common radius.

summary.decision: No automatic optimizer replacement, full-panel expansion, checkpoint promotion or continued training.
summary.scope: Two qualified generator-history conditions, four independent single-batch directions from the same checkpoint. Neither an AdamW-only causal intervention nor a long-run quality comparison.
